title: List of non-OECD countries that are authorized to import certain non-hazardous waste from the EU

triage.reason: The Commission has opened public feedback (18 Sep–16 Oct 2026) on a draft delegated regulation listing non-OECD countries authorised to import certain non-hazardous EU waste under the Waste Shipment Regulation, a concrete implementing step of Regulation (EU) 2024/1157.

draft.summary: The European Commission opened a feedback period from 18 September 2026 to 16 October 2026 on a delegated regulation establishing a list of non-OECD countries authorised to import certain non-hazardous waste from the EU. The new Waste Shipment Regulation bans the export of non-hazardous waste to non-OECD countries from 21 May 2027.

key_dates.text: Feedback period on the delegated regulation ends.
The new Waste Shipment Regulation bans the export of non-hazardous waste to non-OECD countries from 21 May 2027.

draft.interpretation: Recyclers and exporters of certain non-hazardous waste may need to monitor the final list of authorised non-OECD countries, as exports to unlisted non-OECD countries will be prohibited from 21 May 2027.
